ruling.recommended_action: Raise a Type-2 fare adjustment (voucher) of S$5.49 to the rider for the unexempt AYE loop detour; record the RD-1 shortest-route violation on T-2006/meter 21.57 km vs quoted 16.587 km.

segment_findings.reason: Closed loop off the quoted AYE corridor around Jurong East (GPS ~21:56–22:03; looping points 2.5–3.2 km from the quoted polyline, well beyond the 300 m match radius), adding ~3.9 km; the only traffic incident was reported 21:57:50 — after the segment start — and states 'towards Jurong East MRT', i.e. on the carriageway the driver was already using, so it does not corroborate a closure of the replaced optimal section at 21:56 (RD-4(a)/(b) not satisfied); the AYE speed band 5 for the full trip window indicates the replaced route was free-flowing. Chat shows no rider-requested stop, no prior route notice and no rider consent (RD-3/RD-5 not satisfied). Unexempt; refund per RD-2.
